title: Evaluator implementation descriptor
description: File an evaluator implementation ships so a loader can install and run it with no code that knows that implementation by name. This is separate from the result descriptor in docs/evaluator-descriptor.md. See docs/implementation-descriptor.md.

format.description: The format stays /1. New kinds widen the kind enum additively in a later minor version of this contract. A consumer MUST refuse a kind it does not know.

id.description: The evaluator.id this implementation writes on its results.

kind.description: integrity only. A later minor version widens this enum additively. A consumer MUST refuse a kind it does not know.

grading.description: none only in this version. This implementation does not grade.

package.description: It installs from the descriptor's own repository at the same commit as the descriptor. The descriptor never names another source.

name.description: PEP 508 distribution name. A path, URL, git+ locator, or 40-character hexadecimal commit is rejected.

python.description: Fixed at 3.12 for now and will widen later.

module.description: Python module a loader runs with python -m.

arguments.description: Ordered arguments. A string may contain only the placeholders {evidence_manifest}, {media_dir}, and {result}. {evidence_manifest} and {result} must each appear in a top-level string. A conditional is included only when that input is present, and conditionals do not nest.

exit_codes.description: Any exit code not listed in exit_codes is a failure with no result. Code 0 is required and means result.

result.description: The result format this implementation writes. Consumers must check that the produced result's format equals the declared value and that its major is one they support.

argument.description: An argument string. The only brace tokens it may contain are {evidence_manifest}, {media_dir}, and {result}.

conditional.description: Included only when the named input is present. then is a non-empty list of argument strings. Conditionals do not nest.
